name: Eolambia
sum: A hadrosauroid of the early Late Cretaceous of Utah, named in 1998 as the "dawn lambeosaurine".
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; from the Cedar Mountain Formation, Utah.
material: Numerous elements, including vertebrae, dentary and dentition, from a bonebed.
